sources.description: Numbers typed by the project authors to exercise the pipeline and the playable slice (growth curve, base experience, EV yield, catch rate, level-up moves, reward packages). They are NOT claimed to match any game and must be replaced by a properly sourced dataset before any release. Learnset entries were chosen to be legal moves of the pinned Showdown build; where that build has Gen 8 level-up data the levels agree with it (see the content inventory).
sources.license: project-authored test data; no third-party terms apply, and no claim of equivalence with any commercial game is made
sources.ref: docs/step2/2.3-report.md (stand-in values entered by hand at step 2.3)

sources.description: Battle data (base stats, display names, move names) is read from the pinned Pokemon Showdown build at run time and is never copied into the framework content.
sources.license: MIT (code and data files of the smogon/pokemon-showdown repository); the data describes a franchise whose rights belong to its owners, so the MIT grant does not by itself settle redistribution of the game data inside a product
